description: Uncover the real story behind your business processes. Process Mining Visual by Datellers is a powerful Power BI custom visual that transforms raw event log data into interactive process flow diagrams. It automatically reconstructs how your processes actually run, revealing bottlenecks, deviations, and rework loops so you can compare real-world execution against your ideal process. Instead of relying on assumptions about how a process "should" work, Process Mining lets you see exactly how it does work, built directly from your Case ID, Activity, and Timestamp data, helping you uncover inefficiencies, hidden variants, and improvement opportunities hiding in plain sight. Key Features Golden Path Highlighting: Instantly surface the most common route through your process, with optional glow and animated flow particles to draw the eye to what matters most. Bottleneck Heat Mapping: Color activities and transitions by case count or duration to immediately spot where cases pile up or slow down. Variant Analysis: Explore every distinct path your process actually takes, ranked and displayed in a dedicated variants panel for fast comparison. Transition Metrics: Display case counts, durations, and other key statistics directly on the flow diagram for clear, in-context insight.
